intro: Bangladesh is one of the most crowded countries on Earth, with well over 150 million people living in an area smaller than England and Wales together.

chapters.title: Bengali nation
text: Almost everyone speaks Bengali (Bangla), and most people are Muslim, with a sizeable Hindu minority. Indigenous peoples such as the Chakma and Marma live in the hill tracts.
Around a million Rohingya refugees from Myanmar live in camps near Cox's Bazar.

chapters.title: Life and cities
text: Dhaka is one of the fastest-growing and most densely packed cities in the world, famous for its cycle rickshaws. Life expectancy and schooling for girls have improved a lot since 1971.
